headline: Flat miles today — the climb still needs its own work
body:
Today's 15.7 miles at 370 feet is honest recovery volume and nothing more; it adds a little to the distance axis and essentially nothing to the climbing one. The week sits at 41.9 miles and 1,798 feet, a real rebuild after the 8.1- and 15.7-mile weeks in mid-September, so the trend is finally pointing up. But be clear about where you stand 16 days out: your longest ride is 27.7 miles and your biggest single day of climbing is 1,819 feet. The route asks 62 miles and 6,600 feet, with Gibraltar alone at 2,551 feet after you've already ridden 30-plus.

Distance is behind; climbing is further behind. Ride Friday morning long and early before the 85. Saturday, start at sunrise for a foothill climbing day — 90 by afternoon. Sunday and Wednesday, near 91 with warm nights, keep it short or rest. The weeks left need one 40-mile day and two rides over 2,000 feet.
